description: DTW (Dynamic Time Warping) lag features between lateral GR window and typewell GR. For each row, compute DTW distance at multiple lag offsets and extract the best-matching lag and distance profile. Complements cross-correlation in exp003 by being robust to local stretching/squeezing of the GR signal.
implementation_notes: Use fastdtw or a hand-coded constrained DTW with Sakoe-Chiba band (radius=5) for speed.
For each row, take a centered GR window of size 41 from the lateral well, and compare to the typewell GR at lag offsets in [-40, +40] (step 2 is fine for speed).
Cache typewell GR series per well to avoid recomputation.
Aggressively downsample (every 5th MD row) for the DTW computation, then interpolate features back to all rows — total runtime budget < 30 min.
Use GroupKFold(5) by well_id. Compare CV RMSE to exp_b001 (37.11). Add code to src/features.py.
